label: FUS::CREB3L2

sections.text: FUS encodes an RNA-binding protein involved in RNA processing and transcriptional regulation.
CREB3L2 encodes an endoplasmic-reticulum-associated bZIP transcription factor involved in secretory-cell function.

The fusion joins the amino-terminal FET-family activation region to CREB3L DNA-binding sequences and creates an aberrant bZIP transcription factor. FUS::CREB3L2 occurs in low-grade fibromyxoid sarcoma; CREB3L2 is the more common partner.
